children: Israel AI analytics provider's fiscal Q2 revenue grew 12% yr/yr, operating income missed estimates
Non-GAAP diluted EPS for Q2 nearly doubled yr/yr
Company repurchased 1.5 mln shares during H1 FYE27 under buyback program
Cognyte sees FYE27 revenue at $448 mln, with a range of +/- 2%
Company expects FYE27 adjusted EBITDA of about $68 mln at midpoint of revenue range
Cognyte forecasts FYE27 non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.47 at midpoint of revenue range
SOFTWARE DEMAND - Co said Q2 revenue growth was driven by consistent demand for its software solutions
RECURRING REVENUE - Growth in recurring revenue was primarily driven by adoption of subscription offerings
REVENUE MIX SHIFT - Higher software content and reduced professional services supported margin improvement
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for COGNYTE SOFTWARE LTD. is $13.00, about 58% above its September 8 closing price of $8.23
The stock recently traded at 14 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 21 three months ago
